newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Six people gassed to death in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Six people gassed to death in Hong Kong.

text.p: Six people, including two children, were gassed to death on Tuesday in what appeared to be a suicide and murder pact in a Hong Kong flat, police said.

"It appears from the set-up of the flat this was a suicide pact and murder because there were pipes run through to the bedrooms from the gas tap," police superintendent Robert Highfield said. "Air-conditioners and windows were sealed."
A seventh person was in hospital receiving treatment. The seven were comatose when firefighters found them, police said.
